about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-reminders.mjs (a made-up student). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

bank account.ask: Yes, can you remind me to open a bank account?
bank account.reply: You can add that to your checklist here with {{task: Open a bank account}}.

two things.ask: Yes please, opening a bank account and getting a bus pass
two things.reply: I can add getting a bus pass to your checklist. {{task: Get a bus pass}}

add it for me.ask: Yes, add it for me please
add it for me.reply: Only you can add it to your checklist by tapping the button on the card. Would you like to check what else is left on your checklist?

already there.ask: Yes, can you remind me to register with a GP?
already there.reply: That is already on your checklist, along with finding a dentist. You can view them anytime on your [[Checklist]].

worried.ask: I’m really worried about money, I can’t afford food this week
worried.reply: I am really sorry to hear that you are going through this. Have a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] for immediate help with food and money worries.

conversation.reply: Unpacking can take a while, so take your time with it. [[Chess]] is a great way to unwind once you've finished, and [[Events]] is good for meeting people.
Yes, [[Chess]] is right here at Northumbria.
You can check out [[Gigs]] for live music and events at the Students' Union.
You're very welcome. Is there anything you'd like reminding about while you settle in, like opening a bank account?
That is fine. If you change your mind, just let me know.
And you, have a good evening too. Let me know if you need anything else.
